latest.title: Revisiting Picard's proof of the Picard--Weber--Weck selection theorem
latest.abstract: Revisiting the rationale provided by Picard in the seminal paper [13], we provide an independent, self-contained proof of the Maxwell compactness property for weak Lipschitz domains in the Euclidean setting, detouring technical complications like the differential forms setting, Gaffney's inequality for smooth domains, Calderon's extension theorem or regularity theory for PDEs, or systems thereof, on smooth domains that are used in this context. As a by-product we provide an independent proof of the classical Gaffney estimate for cubes using only $L^2$-completeness of the Fourier bases.
latest.workSummary: 论文证明弱 Lipschitz 域上的 Maxwell compactness，并给出 Picard–Weber–Weck 选择定理与 cube 上 Gaffney 估计。
latest.breakthrough: Theorem 1.1 统一表述 Picard–Weber–Weck 选择；Theorems 2.7–2.8 分别处理弱 Lipschitz 域和单位 cube。
latest.limitations: 域需满足 weak Lipschitz/global Lipschitz 条件；边界算子采用最大 L2 域，结论是 Hilbert 空间框架下的紧嵌入。

steps.claim: Theorem 2.11 给出抽象 Hilbert 复形中的紧性判据。
steps.route: 以弱零序列为测试，利用 adjoint domain 的闭性和 coercive graph norm，证明 Curl/div 交集中的序列具有强收敛子列。
steps.evidence: PDF 第8–10页，第2节 Theorem 2.11 及 Proof。

steps.claim: Theorem 2.7 将抽象判据应用于弱 Lipschitz 域。
steps.route: 先用局部双 Lipschitz 图把域切分为 cube 型片段，再用 partition of unity 将局部 Curl/div 估计拼合。
steps.evidence: PDF 第5–9页，第2节 Theorem 2.7 及 Proof of Theorem 2.7。

steps.claim: Theorem 2.8 与 Theorem 4.10 建立 cube Gaffney 结果并完成选择定理。
steps.route: 在单位 cube 上直接构造边界延拓/反射，得到精确 Gaffney 界；再通过 Theorem 4.10 回代一般域并推出 Theorem 1.1。
steps.evidence: PDF 第5页 Theorem 2.8；PDF 第约20页第4节 Theorem 4.10；第2页 Theorem 1.1。
